Messages.Author: Mathieu Dewavrin
Messages.Body:
Hello all

Lotus Noir (a french monthly about card games) has spoiled a card from Black
hands.

I don't know if it has already been told on this forum but here it is.

Dia de los Muertos
1 Pool
The first referendum a Sabbat vampire you control calls on this turn
automatically passes. Only one Dia de los muertos can be played in a game.

We also learnt that there will be 7 new advanced vampires in the set.

Enjoy !

Mathieu DEWAVRIN
Price of Nantes - Bretagne

There is another potential problem I see with Dia de los Muertos.

I think most of us agree that a lot of the *really* nasty votes fortunately
can't be combined with Dia since they require Camarilla vampires (PTO, Parity
Shift, Kindred Restructure, Justicar Retribution, Anathema, Archon, etc.). If
Dia worked on those votes, I'd be really *really* worry.

While some of us might have initially celebrated the existence of Dia de los
Muertos, also bear in mind that the existence of the card might preclude Sabbat
vote cards of a power level equivalent to that of the Camarilla. I'm pretty
sure the Sabbat definitely *won't* be getting their own version of Justicar
Retribution or PTO, especially since Dia will be floating around.

Just a thought.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 09 Oct 2003 17:23:42 -0400, LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com>
scrawled:

>Jon Stahler wrote:
>> Hmm...thought there was something about modifiers being played on votes that
>> are automatically passing. Must be particular tot he presence mods...
>
>It is "particular" to the effects played "during a referendum".
>The ones played after are not affected.

for example, you can't Delaying Tactics an auto-pass vote, because
it's _during_ the referendum, which there is no during bit with
auto-pass.
You CAN Voter Cap an auto-pass vote, but for 0 blood/pool, because
it's after a successful referendum.

Although..........

an auto-pass vote, presumably, still must set terms.
and, according to 6.3.2:

'The referendum consists of three steps: setting the terms, polling
(casting votes) and resolving the referendum.
1. Choose the terms, if any, of the referendum. Cards that
are used “during a political action” but “before votes are
cast” are used at this time.'

so, with an auto-pass vote, you still move into the 'referendum' part,
however briefly (just long enough to set terms, presumably).

in the step 1 above, are the only 'during a referendum' cards that you
are allowed to play those that specify 'before votes are cast', or can
you play any 'during a referendum/PA', as appropriate? like gaining
votes and DT, etc...even if it's an auto-pass vote? :/

I seem to recall something about a RT review of this early step in the
referendum, but can't recall the exact nature of the review....

Messages.Author: the_capuchin
Messages.Body:
> I think most of us agree that a lot of the *really* nasty votes fortunately
> can't be combined with Dia since they require Camarilla vampires (PTO, Parity
> Shift, Kindred Restructure, Justicar Retribution, Anathema, Archon, etc.). If
> Dia worked on those votes, I'd be really *really* worry.

Don't know why. Camarilla clans have access to better cards to
guarantee that the vote will pass, like Malkavian Rider Clause,
Charming Lobby etc., and they don't cost a pool.

I know you would think "but Charming Lobby is an action that could be
blocked blah blah" - indeed, but if your prey can block a charming
lobby, he probably will be able to block the nasty votes above too.

I think Dia de Los Muertos is a very interesting card. First, because
it does boost a little Sabbat voting but has a major drawback (only
one per game). Second, for thematically reasons - it's a master card,
and since everybody knows that Sabbat minions usually can't fight with
the Camarilla in the political/mortal affairs arena, a Methuselah
direct intervention (no pun intended) is just fitting.
